summary: Useful variants combine scheduled coverage with incremental analysis and event-triggered urgent checks.

items.text: Reuse the same named standards and verdict schema as per-change quality-gate agents.
Schedule a specification-to-code drift sweep with component-level fingerprints so unchanged areas can be skipped.
Publish each run as a trendable analysis report with new, resolved, suppressed and overdue findings.
Model scheduled, event-driven and manual sweeps as one pipeline with different triggers but identical evidence outputs.
